entries.subject: Metglas 2714A (Co-based amorphous alloy) — candidate LOGIC core material

properties.squareness: high (manufacturer: 'high squareness ratio - low coercive force')
properties.coercivity_note: Not stated numerically in the bulletin text; hysteresis loop figure only. Literature class: sub-A/m to few A/m. DO NOT use a precise value until extracted from the loop figure or a second datasheet.

entries.design_implication: Matches Argon-review fix for logic cores (near-zero magnetostriction -> Villari lockup immunity). Trade: Bs = 0.57 T vs Fe-based 1.56 T shrinks the flux reservoir dPhi = 2*Br*Ac by ~2.7x — the fan-out budget gets worse; clock restoration is not optional.

entries.subject: Metglas 2605SA1 (Fe-based amorphous alloy) — candidate SENSING core material
entries.grade: DATASHEET (manufacturer); numeric table partially image-locked in PDF — values below are from the manufacturer's materials page and the alloy's published class figures

properties.coercivity_note: Fe-BMG class figure ~44 A/m was the value used in the Argon review arithmetic; the SA1 bulletin presents DC hysteresis as curves (Single Strip Test), not a tabulated Hc. Treat 44 A/m as CLASS-REPORTED, not SA1-datasheet-extracted.

entries.design_implication: lambda_s = 27 ppm is the Villari sensing channel (Argon: 2 MPa -> dH ~150 A/m). Use where strain sensing is wanted; keep away from logic cores (radiation-shrinkage lockup path).
